themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents that perform research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including research assistants and automated research platforms.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code, including AI coding agents and tools that interact with code.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Discusses the use of AI in evaluating the user-friendliness and effectiveness of products and interfaces, often through automated checks or AI-driven feedback.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Explores how AI is used to analyze datasets, extract insights, and identify patterns, often in the context of user research or market analysis.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to enhance and streamline the research process for professionals.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Examines the impact and application of AI in the recruitment process, including AI's effect on job roles and hiring practices.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on studies and discussions about the accuracy, reliability, and user experience of AI-powered chatbots.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Analyzes how AI is used to interpret and measure user emotions, opinions, and feedback from various sources.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to condense long texts, documents, or conversations into shorter, digestible summaries.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discusses how AI is changing job roles, skills requirements, and the overall dynamics of the workforce.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
